crossRefs.note: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter…
Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt…

parallels.note: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.
The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
translations.bsb: For the Levites, then, there were forty-eight cities in all, together with their pasturelands, within the territory of the Israelites.
translations.kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
translations.asv: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
